notes.title: 4.1 Christmas Update
notes.notes:
Christmas

Better UI

Startup
- Fixed issues with the animation not showing correctly.  

Bug Fixes

For Nerds

notes.title: Build 4
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Startup:
- A new intro has been added. The audio is still in progress and will be completed in a future update.

New UI:
- The menu UI has been completely remade from scratch.

Mouse Improvements:
- Ongoing improvements to mouse movement. Check the Steam guide for more features.

Settings Menu Updates:
- The settings menu has a new UI. The upload button issue has been fixed and now redirects you to your dashboard on hexabeat.gg.

XP System Changes:
- The XP system has been rebalanced for smoother progression, and score points are now doubled.

New In-Game Song Editor:
- You can now create and test songs directly within the game. This feature is in beta, and the web version will be discontinued to focus on this one.

Bug Fixes:
- Most UI bugs have been resolved.
- The death menu has been fixed but occasionally doesn't work. You can use 'W,' 'S,' and 'Enter' as a workaround.
- Fixed the texture pack import system.
- Pause menu issues have been addressed but may still intermittently fail. Further updates will address this.

New Features:
- Workshop items can now be updated.
- All older songs will require an update following this release.
- The first mods, such as Mania, Nightcore, and No Fail, are now active.
- The in-game user view now shows whether a user is active.

For Nerds:
- The songs array is now preloaded on startup.
- API changes have been implemented.

notes.title: HEXABEAT EVENT | WIN 10 USD
notes.notes:
HEXABEAT EVENT We are excited to announce the first HexaBeat event, an open tournament for all players!

🎮 Objective: The player who stays in first place on the global level leaderboard by the end of the event will win 10 USD. The prize will be delivered via PayPal or through a gift card of equivalent value (Steam, Xbox, PlayStation).

🕒 Event Duration: From Monday, September 9th to Monday, September 16rd. Stay tuned for more details and rules!

💡 Requirements:

No registration needed; just play HexaBeat to automatically participate.
Have a PayPal account or choose a gift card for Steam, Xbox, or PlayStation worth 10 USD.
The winner will be contacted via Discord, so make sure you're in the official Discord server to participate.

[url=https://phyoxent.com/discord]Discord link[/url]

notes.title: Changelog 3.1
notes.notes:
Intro:
We are testing a new intro, but it's not completely finished.

UI Changes in Select Song:
All difficulties are now in a dropdown to make the menu easier to use.
Fixed the bug where spamming the pause menu would cause it to freeze.
Added new effects to the main menu.

Leaderboard Updates:
The leaderboard now displays your personal ranking at the top.
Only the top 15 players will be shown on the leaderboard.

Mouse Improvements:
The internal functionality of the mouse has been completely reworked, providing better results.

Settings Menu Updates:
Updated the settings menu to simplify adjusting sensitivity with a slider.

XP System Changes:
The XP system has been rebalanced for better progression.

Score Upload Fixes:
Supposedly fixed the issue where your score wouldn’t upload to the leaderboards and independent song scoreboards.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed the bug where creating an account wouldn't add a default profile picture, causing glitches.
Corrected some typographical errors.
Changed some sounds in the main menu, though a few more still need updating.
Fixed the bug where enabling RAW Input would deactivate the song cache. RAW Input is now fully implemented, though it significantly affects mouse sensitivity.
Fixed the resolution dropdown to now select the highest resolution by default.

New Features:
You can now adjust the game quality settings, though this will directly affect the quality of images and sprites.

For Nerds:
We’ve switched to the IL2CPP backend for better performance.

notes.title: Build 3 Release
notes.notes:
Build 3 (3.0)

Steam Workshop functionality added: Simply by subscribing, items will automatically download.
Achievements: New achievements have been implemented.
Texture Packs: Support for texture packs has been added.
About Song on NavBar: Added an "About Song" section to the navigation bar.
Better Health: Improved health system.
Bug Fix: Resolved issue where some songs were not showing.
ChangeLog on NavBar: Added a "ChangeLog" section to the navigation bar.
Notification Fix: Resolved issues with notifications.
Sound Bug Fixes: Addressed various sound-related bugs.
For Nerds:

Cache System for Songs: Cache system for songs can now be disabled for compatibility issues (Account & Extras → Toggle Cache).
Notification Pivot Point Fix: Fixed the pivot point for spawning notifications.
SFX Sounds Linked to Mixer: Missing SFX sounds are now linked to the mixer.
Updating Firebase Dependencies: Updated Firebase C++ SDK to version 12.2.0.
Steamworks/Steam Dependencies Fix: Addressed issues with Steamworks/Steam dependencies using C++/.NET.
